mapper.sql: tenant_id, session_id, target_kind, target_id, agent_id, end_user_id, session_sequence, input_id, run_id, execution_id, action_id, delegation_id, event_id, event_fingerprint, event_type, event_version, trace_id, span_id, root_input_id, caused_by_event_id, payload_schema_id, public.agent_runtime_session_event_payload(tenant_id, session_id, target_kind, target_id, end_user_id, run_id, event_id, event_type, payload_schema_id, payload_canonical_json) AS payload_canonical_json, occurred_at_epoch_second, occurred_at_nano
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_session_owners (tenant_id, session_id, target_kind, target_id, end_user_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{targetKind}, #{targetId}, #{endUserId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_session_streams (tenant_id, session_id, target_kind, target_id, end_user_id, next_sequence) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{targetKind}, #{targetId}, #{endUserId}, 1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_session_events ( tenant_id, session_id, target_kind, target_id, agent_id, end_user_id, session_sequence, input_id, run_id, execution_id, action_id, delegation_id, event_id, event_fingerprint, event_type, event_version, trace_id, span_id, root_input_id, caused_by_event_id, payload_schema_id, payload_canonical_json, occurred_at_epoch_second, occurred_at_nano) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{targetKind}, #{targetId}, #{agentId}, #{endUserId}, #{sessionSequence}, #{inputId}, #{runId}, #{executionId}, #{actionId}, #{delegationId}, #{eventId}, #{eventFingerprint}, #{eventType}, #{eventVersion}, #{traceId}, #{spanId}, #{rootInputId}, #{causedByEventId}, #{payloadSchemaId}, #{payloadCanonicalJson}, #{occurredAtEpochSecond}, #{occurredAtNano})

INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_session_event_bodies (tenant_id,target_kind,target_id,session_id,end_user_id,content_hash,canonical_content) VALUES(#{row.tenantId},#{row.targetKind},#{row.targetId},#{row.sessionId},#{row.endUserId},#{digest},#{canonical}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,target_kind,target_id,session_id,content_hash) DO NOTHING
